'''Enkep''' was the innermost [[Planet/Legends|planet]] orbiting the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Katorrs]] in the [[Adumar system/Legends|Katorrs system]], located on the galactic frontier, along the inner edge of [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]. Enkep was a [[Magma/Legends|molten]] rock without any [[Moon/Legends|moons]].<ref name="WA" />

==Behind the scenes==
All worlds in the [[Adumar system/Legends|Katorrs system]], except [[Adumar/Legends|Adumar]], were designed for the article [[Adumar: Pilots Wanted]] on the [[Wizards of the Coast]] website, compiled by [[Cory J. Herndon]] and published on [[April 1]], [[2004]].<ref name="WA" /> Later, the [[2009]] sourcebook ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', co-authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], placed the Adumar star system in grid square J-6.<ref name="EAOC" />
